description: Get trending niches ranked by BREADTH — how many DISTINCT creators are surging in each niche (not raw episode count), over a 7-day window. Each returns { rank, niche, creators (distinct creators breaking out), breakouts (total breakout episodes), topRelativeScore, momentum (rank change vs the prior window) }. Answers "which corner of the B2B creator market is heating up?". No inputs.
name: trending_niches
